blocks.raw: <Tip>**Credit value hierarchy (highest to lowest):** Teaching/Presentation and Research/Innovation award the most credits; Structured Learning (formal courses, seminars) is moderate; Self-Directed Learning (reading journals, podcasts) awards the fewest. Plan your CPD portfolio accordingly.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <ExamTip>The LEA may test your ability to classify CPD activities. Key distinction: structured learning = formal courses with evaluation; self-directed = independent study without instruction; work-based = learning through actual practice; teaching = instructing others; research = advancing knowledge through investigation.</ExamTip>
